task.description: WF-03 Step 2b hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's design for ISS-0995/Q-976.

Factual claims verified against real code (forward glob, authorization totality, key source, atomics sampling, Obs.Logger/redaction)

result.summary: ROUND 2: PASS. Round 1 was FAIL (2 BLOCKERs: metadata/2 had no spec; test (h) contradicted the sampler on the 1_120 expectation; plus 4 MINORs: LETFLOW_LOG_LEVEL name, trailing-slash route in test (b), (i)(4) determinism, persistent_term race/capture_log audit deferral). Re-validated commit f0548788. All fixed: metadata/2 now has @spec and a contract (fixed key order, authz_suppressed only when n>0, log_denial emits Logger.warning(format_message, metadata) from the same fields); LOG_LEVEL (runtime.exs:198) corrected; test (b) route is /api/v1/definitions/ matching definitions.ex:248; section 8 states conn.method/conn.private/auth_context reads have no local fallback so a non-conn reaches the single outer rescue; the persistent_term race now admits the loser's put is a replacement; capture_log audit is explicit build step 12a.3. Test (h) recomputed independently against section 7: 1000 K#1 emit, K#2-5 withheld (counter 4), other caller and other policy emit (3 lines); 1059 withheld (5); 1060 emit suppressed=5 then K#8 withheld (1); 1120 (60>=60) emit suppressed=1; 1180 emit no suppressed; clock 500 (now<last) emit; window 0 -> 5 lines; invalid windows (-1, x, 1.5) -> 60; 50-task race -> one line then suppressed=49 at 1060. All consistent with the algorithm (CAS single winner, exchange to 0). No new defects found; no TBD; no implementation bodies. Round-1 verification of forward-glob, authorization totality, key source, atomics and Obs.Logger/redaction claims stands. No mix commands run.

issues.description: Test (i)(4) hedges the exception module ('whatever the implementation raises, asserted against the same regexp'); acceptable, but TEST-DESIGNER should assert the regexp class=error exception=Elixir\.\w+ rather than FunctionClauseError literally (a non-conn atom field access raises a different error).

result.next_action: ORCH: proceed to ELIXIR-DEV with the design (build steps 12a); SECURITY-REVIEWER gate applies (INV-4 primary).
